name: SurvivalSpecialWaveProfile - Default (seed v1)
description: A special-wave enemy profile of a survival scenario (DESIGN S14, S53): its own mix and count, replacing the normal wave or added on top of it. Scheduled by special-wave entries.

steps.description: Name the profile. Its key is what the schedule and the plugin refer to.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The siege scenario this belongs to; filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_', unique per scenario, e.g. 'wolves'.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown to players when the wave starts, e.g. 'Wolf pack'.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Leave empty to add it after the existing profiles.

steps.description: How many enemies the special wave has and whether it replaces the normal wave. Save the profile first, then add its monster types; none = the scenario's normal mix.

fields.label: Fixed count
fields.description: A fixed enemy count for this wave. Leave empty to derive it from the normal count.

fields.label: Count multiplier
fields.description: Without a fixed count: the normal count × this (default 1).

fields.label: Add to the normal wave
fields.description: Off (default): the profile replaces the normal composition. On: it is added on top of it (boss events).

fields.label: Monster types
fields.description: Create New opens the monster type form with this profile filled in.
